basic_details.short_information: Central Warehousing Corporation (CWC) has announced recruitment for 1 Consultant vacancy on a contract basis under advertisement number CWC CO-PD0RECT/5/2020-PERSONNEL. The engagement is initially for one (01) year with tenure extendable up to the age of 65 years for New Delhi posting. Candidates require experience in dealing with promotion and upgradation matters, including preparation and processing of DPC/LDCE cases and interpretation of relevant service rules. The pay is 50% of the last drawn Pay (Basic plus Dearness allowance). Eligible applicants must apply online from 9 October 2026 to

Fill out the online application form for the Consultant position between 09.10.2026 and 23.10.2026.
Upload scanned copies of your SSC/Xth certificate as proof of Date of Birth.

Submit the application online before the last date.

rows.details: Initially for one (01) year, extendable up to 65 years of age
50% of last drawn Pay (Basic plus Dearness allowance), subject to pension adjustment rules
Up to the age of 65 years

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be ex-officers of Central Warehousing Corporation fulfilling the required experience and eligibility conditions: Required Experience: Experience in dealing with promotion and upgradation matters, including preparation and processing of DPC/LDCE cases, and interpretation of relevant service rules and precedents. Pay Scale/Level Experience: Must have worked in IDA Scale 60000-180000 (E-3). Vigilance Condition: There should be no disciplinary or criminal proceedings or charge sheet pending against the applicant, nor any punishment awarded by the organisation/s served for the last 10 years before superannuation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Consultant will receive a monthly consolidated remuneration equal to 50% of their last drawn Pay (Basic plus Dearness allowance). Provided that the amount of pension received from all sources does not exceed this prescribed remuneration; if pension exceeds 50% of the last drawn pay, the excess pension amount will be deducted from the remuneration. No other benefits are admissible except consolidated remuneration, and TA/DA/Hotel charges are payable as per the eligibility of the last post held at retirement (subject to a maximum of E-8 Level) during official tours.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CWC Consultant
content_sections.text: Visit the official career portal at https://www.cwceportal.com/Careers . Fill out the online application form for the Consultant position between 09.10.2026 and 23.10.2026. Upload scanned copies of your SSC/Xth certificate as proof of Date of Birth. Upload self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates (provisional/original). Upload self-attested copies of experience/service certificates, relieving certificate from the last employer, and last drawn pay certificate. Upload a duly signed copy of the Undertaking for Vigilance Clearance proforma (Annexure-II). Submit the application online before the last date.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is through Personal Interaction. Candidates who fulfill the eligibility criteria will be called for the personal interaction. Information regarding the schedule will be communicated through email or the CWC website.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: This is a contractual engagement as a Consultant, initially for one (01) year, which may be extended yearly up to the age of 65 years based on performance and departmental requirements.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for this position?
faq.answer: Ex-officers of Central Warehousing Corporation who have experience working in the IDA Scale 60000-180000 (E-3) and possess experience in dealing with promotion, upgradation, and DPC/LDCE matters are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly remuneration provided?
faq.answer: The remuneration is 50% of the last drawn pay (Basic plus Dearness allowance), subject to the condition that pension received from all sources does not exceed this amount. Any excess pension is deducted from the remuneration.

faq.question: Q4. What documents need to be uploaded during online application?
faq.answer: Candidates must upload SSC/Xth certificate for date of birth, educational qualification certificates, experience/service certificates, relieving certificate from last employer, last drawn pay certificate, and a signed vigilance clearance undertaking.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 23 October 2026.
